permission.notes: Owner confirmed applicable Earth3 geometry/adjacency may be used, converted, modified, and redistributed in Gates of Code:X. Archive and background tiles stay uncommitted.

assumptions: Earth3 continent id is metadata only; crop uses authored rect + whole-polygon rules.
Far-northern Scandinavia is excluded by min_y, not by deleting Norway/Sweden/Finland entirely.
Iceland remains included because its centroids sit south of the far-north cutoff while still west of the main mass.
No province rings are clipped; boundary spill uses whole-polygon keep when centroid is inside.
AoH3 background tiles and scenarios are not imported.
Arkhangelsk may still fall inside the northern Russian fringe of em_ref_tight; owner may raise min_y or add exclude IDs if that is too deep.
Region coverage is validated via Earth3 city anchors, not political ownership.
